title: User
description: Global user identity (email is globally unique). Not org-scoped; membership to orgs is modeled via Membership objects.

email.description: Primary email address. Globally unique across REAP. Can be changed only via verified email-change flow.

name.description: Display name as shown in the UI.

status.description: Account state at the global user level. Independent of per-org membership status.

emailVerified.description: True if this email has been verified by REAP (via SSO assertion or verification flow).

mfaEnabled.description: True if MFA is enabled for this user (applies to local sign-ins only; SSO enforces MFA at the IdP).

authMethods.description: Authentication methods available for this user account.

lastLoginAt.description: Timestamp (UTC) of the most recent successful login.

lockedUntil.description: If present, local sign-in is locked (e.g., due to rate limiting) until this time.
